_meta.description: Golden evaluation set for the Aldermere Advisory proposal-response corpus (sample_docs/proposal_corpus/). 38 answerable items plus 12 deliberate traps — questions that sound like real RFP questions but ask for facts the corpus does not contain. Correct behaviour on a trap is an explicit refusal (per the SYSTEM_PROMPT in app/services/rag_chain.py), not a fluent guess.

items.question: In what year was Aldermere Advisory founded?
Where are Aldermere's two offices located?
items.expected_answer: London (headquarters) and Manchester

items.question: How many staff does Aldermere employ?
What is the employee-count range of organisations Aldermere works with?
items.expected_answer: 50 to 500 employees

items.question: What information security certification does Aldermere hold?
What percentage of Aldermere's new engagements come from repeat clients or referral rather than competitive tender?
How many properties did the housing association client in Case Study 1 manage?
items.expected_answer: Approximately 14,000

items.question: By what percentage did the retailer's order-to-fulfilment cycle time improve in Case Study 2?
What was the manual reconciliation effort, in hours per quarter, before and after the retail engagement?
items.expected_answer: Fell from 480 to approximately 90 hours per quarter

items.question: How long did the AI-augmented document review pilot for the law firm run before being extended?
items.expected_answer: 10 weeks

items.question: What was the first-draft turnaround time for engagement letters after the AI pilot, compared with before?
items.expected_answer: Fell from 3 working days to approximately 4 hours

items.question: What professional qualification does Priya Narayanan hold?
items.expected_answer: ACA (ICAEW), Chartered Accountant

items.question: Where did Tom Whitfield complete his MBA?
items.expected_answer: Warwick Business School

items.question: What is Dr Ines Falk's academic background?
items.expected_answer: PhD in Computer Science (natural language processing), University of Edinburgh

items.question: What professional qualification does Marcus Oduya hold?
items.expected_answer: CIMA

items.question: Where did Freya Lindqvist complete her MSc, and in what subject?
items.expected_answer: MSc Business Analytics, Imperial College London

items.question: What is Aldermere's minimum staffing requirement for an engagement lasting more than four weeks?
items.expected_answer: At least one Engagement Director or above as engagement lead, plus at least one Senior Consultant

items.question: What is the day rate for a Managing Partner?
items.expected_answer: £1,850 per day, excluding VAT

items.question: What is the day rate for a Business Analyst?
items.expected_answer: £550 per day, excluding VAT

items.question: What is Aldermere's standard notice period to pause or terminate an ongoing engagement?
items.expected_answer: Four weeks' written notice by either party

items.question: How long do quoted day rates remain valid before review?
items.expected_answer: 12 months from the date of the proposal, then reviewed in line with RPI

items.question: What is the expense cap under Aldermere's standard commercial terms?
items.expected_answer: Expenses at cost, capped at 12% of professional fees unless a higher cap is agreed in writing

items.question: What is the minimum engagement length under the standard rate card?
items.expected_answer: Four weeks, except fixed-scope diagnostic engagements priced separately

items.question: How long do Aldermere's confidentiality obligations survive after an engagement ends?
items.expected_answer: 3 years

items.question: Who owns the intellectual property in deliverables produced specifically for a client?
items.expected_answer: The client

items.question: What is Aldermere's professional indemnity insurance cover?
items.expected_answer: £5 million per claim

items.question: What is Aldermere's public liability insurance cover?
items.expected_answer: £10 million

items.question: What is the liability cap under Aldermere's standard terms, and what exceptions apply?
items.expected_answer: Capped at 100% of fees paid in the preceding 12 months, except gross negligence, wilful misconduct, or breach of confidentiality, which are uncapped

items.question: How quickly must Aldermere delete or return client data after a written request at the end of an engagement?
items.expected_answer: Within 30 days

items.question: What is Aldermere's escalation path for unresolved delivery issues?
items.expected_answer: First to the named engagement lead, then to the Managing Partner if unresolved within 5 working days, with mediation required before formal legal proceedings

items.question: How many weeks did the finance function redesign engagement last, and what were its phases?
items.expected_answer: 14 weeks: Discover (2 weeks), Design (3 weeks), Deliver (7 weeks), Embed (2 weeks)

items.question: What was the estimated total fee for the finance function redesign engagement?
items.expected_answer: Approximately £66,500

items.question: What was the principal delivery risk identified in the retail digital operations proposal, and how was it mitigated?
items.expected_answer: In-store trading disruption during rollout, mitigated by sequencing the rollout store-by-store with a full trading week's validation per cohort

items.question: What was the estimated total fee for the retail digital operations engagement?
items.expected_answer: Approximately £80,000 across 16 weeks

items.question: Who was the engagement sponsor on the finance function redesign proposal, and what is her day rate under the standard rate card?
items.expected_answer: Priya Narayanan, Managing Partner, £1,850 per day

items.question: Which practice area led the retail digital operations engagement, and who leads that practice?
items.expected_answer: Operations & Process Transformation, led by Tom Whitfield

items.question: What case study resulted from the finance function redesign proposal, and what was its headline outcome?
items.expected_answer: Case Study 1; month-end close reduced from 12 working days to 5 working days

items.question: Which qualification does the leader of the Applied AI & Automation practice hold, and what engagement did she lead?
items.expected_answer: Dr Ines Falk holds a PhD in Computer Science (NLP); she led the AI-augmented document review pilot for a regional law firm

items.question: What manufacturing-sector engagements has Aldermere delivered?
items.notes: Sectors served are professional services, financial services, housing/public sector, and mid-market retail — manufacturing is not listed anywhere in the corpus.

items.question: What is Aldermere's day rate for expert witness or litigation support work?
items.notes: rate_card.md explicitly states this is 'quoted separately' — no figure is given.

items.question: What is the day rate for Consultant James Okafor?
items.notes: No such individual appears anywhere in team_credentials.md or elsewhere in the corpus.

items.question: What system uptime SLA does Aldermere commit to for its Applied AI & Automation tooling?
items.notes: No uptime/SLA figure is stated anywhere in the corpus.

items.question: What is Aldermere's policy on storing client data outside the UK/EEA?
items.notes: standard_terms.md explicitly states non-UK data residency 'must be agreed in writing on a case-by-case basis and are not covered by anything in this corpus'.

items.question: What is Aldermere's average engagement profit margin?
items.notes: Not disclosed anywhere in the corpus.

items.question: Does Aldermere offer a money-back guarantee if an engagement fails to hit its targets?
items.notes: No guarantee or refund clause appears in standard_terms.md or elsewhere.

items.question: What is Aldermere's cyber liability insurance coverage limit?
items.notes: Only professional indemnity (£5m) and public liability (£10m) are stated; no separate cyber policy figure exists in the corpus.

items.question: Does Aldermere offer volume discounts for multi-year framework agreements?
items.notes: Not mentioned anywhere in rate_card.md or standard_terms.md.

items.question: How many engagements has Aldermere had escalated to formal legal proceedings?
items.notes: standard_terms.md describes the escalation *process* but gives no historical count.

items.question: Which named subcontractors does Aldermere use for specialist skills outside its four practice areas?
items.notes: rate_card.md describes the pass-through pricing mechanism but names no actual subcontractors.

items.question: What was Aldermere's revenue in its most recent financial year?
items.notes: No revenue or financial-performance figure appears anywhere in the corpus.
